integrity: The classical scalar moment inequality is not claimed as new; the sharp application, reflected-block comparison, and all-condition-number extremizers constitute the finding. Independent review has not occurred.
limitations: Conditional one-step expected squared-residual progress only, in full-column-rank least squares with exact reflected-block projection; no time-to-accuracy or hardware-cost claim.
title: Sharp conditioning penalty for gradient-norm sampling in symmetric block Gauss–Seidel
